questions.question: When did the chest pain start? Did it come on suddenly or develop gradually?
On a scale of 1 to 10, how severe is the chest discomfort right now?
Does the pain radiate to your left arm, shoulder, neck, jaw, or back?
Are you having difficulty breathing or shortness of breath along with the pain?
Are you experiencing heavy cold sweating, nausea, or dizziness?

red_flag_indicators: severe chest pain
chest pain with breathing difficulty
chest pain with fainting
chest pain with severe sweating
crushing chest pain radiating to left arm

questions.question: Which specific joints are hurting (e.g. knees, hips, hands, shoulders)?
How long have you had this joint pain?
On a scale of 1 to 10, how severe is the joint pain?
Do you experience stiffness in the joints, especially in the morning?
Is there any visible swelling, redness, or heat around the joints?

red_flag_indicators: severe sudden joint pain
inability to move the joint
inability to bear weight
severe swelling
joint symptoms with high fever

questions.question: How long have you had this knee pain?
On a scale of 1 to 10, how intense is the knee pain?
Did the knee pain start gradually or suddenly after an injury?
Do your knees feel stiff or make cracking sounds when bending or walking?

red_flag_indicators: inability to bear any weight on knee
knee joint locked in one position
severe sudden knee swelling and hot red joint

questions.question: How many days have you had this fever?
Does the fever come with shivering, chills, or heavy sweating?
Do you have any cough, sore throat, vomiting, rash, or burning urination?

red_flag_indicators: fever with stiff neck and altered mental state
fever with persistent vomiting and extreme lethargy
fever with breathing difficulty or blue lips

questions.question: How long have you had this cough?
Is it a dry cough or are you bringing up phlegm/mucus?
Are you having any wheezing, chest tightness, or trouble breathing?

red_flag_indicators: coughing up blood (hemoptysis)
severe stridor or inability to speak full sentences
cough with high fever and sudden chest pain

questions.question: Did the headache start suddenly like a thunderclap or build up slowly?
On a scale of 1 to 10, how intense is the headache?
Are you experiencing any vomiting, blurred vision, light sensitivity, or neck stiffness?

red_flag_indicators: thunderclap headache reaching max intensity in seconds
headache with neck stiffness and high fever
headache with sudden weakness or speech difficulty

questions.question: Where in the stomach is the pain located?
When did the stomach pain start and is it continuous or cramping?
On a scale of 1 to 10, how severe is the stomach pain?
Are you experiencing vomiting, loose motions, or fever?

red_flag_indicators: severe rigid abdomen with extreme tenderness
vomiting blood or black coffee ground material
black tarry stools with abdominal pain

questions.question: How long have you had this back pain?
On a scale of 1 to 10, how intense is the back pain?
Does the pain shoot down into your legs with tingling or numbness?

red_flag_indicators: back pain with loss of bladder or bowel control (Cauda Equina)
back pain with sudden numbness around saddle/groin area
back pain with sudden leg paralysis

questions.question: When did the vomiting start and how many times have you thrown up?
Are you able to keep water or liquids down?

red_flag_indicators: vomiting fresh red blood or black coffee ground material
vomiting with severe unremitting abdominal pain
inability to keep any fluids for >24h with severe dehydration

questions.question: Does the room feel like it is spinning around you, or is it lightheadedness?
Did you black out, lose consciousness, or fall down?

red_flag_indicators: dizziness with sudden loss of consciousness (syncope)
dizziness with sudden speech slurring or one-sided arm weakness
dizziness accompanied by severe chest pressure or palpitations
